headline: Approved moving the school turf project and Stokes Road bridge removal to 2028, and Pillsbury Cemetery expansion to 2030, in the draft capital plan
summary: Projects were shifted across 2028 to 2030 in the draft capital plan, and security access control systems were combined into 2028. The panel recommended changing the Nelson Road tennis courts restoration to a critical need, and the capital project summary was accepted 4-0.
decisions: Approved the summary of capital projects as presented in the spreadsheet, 4-0.
Approved the minutes of the September 15, 2026 meeting, 3-0-1, with one abstention.
Recommended changing the Nelson Road tennis courts restoration from an essential to a critical need and keeping it a two-year phased project.
Agreed the Stokes Road bridge removal could be moved to 2028, to be further discussed by the Planning Board.
Agreed to combine all security access control systems into 2028.
Agreed the ERP and HRIS finance system should stay in 2028.
Agreed fire apparatus needs to be ordered in 2027, with payment at a future date.
Agreed the Children's Room renovation at Leach Library will take several years, with a bond warrant article for the library renovation in 2028.
Agreed the DPW facility will stay in 2029, most likely funded by a bond and possibly spread across multiple years.
Agreed to purchase a skid steer and mini-excavator in 2028 as an essential need.
Agreed the water project on the capital plan shows a need and approved its proposed schedule.
Agreed to move the Pillsbury Cemetery expansion to 2030.
Agreed to move the school turf field and turf project to 2028.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Burbidge made a motion to accept the summary of capital projects as presented in the spreadsheet reviewed at this meeting. Councilor Paul seconded the motion. The motion carried 4-0-0.
Ms. Burbidge made a motion to approve the minutes from the September 15, 2026 meeting. Councilor Paul seconded the motion. The motion carried 3-0-1, with Mr. Verani abstaining.
The Committee recommended changing the Nelson Road tennis courts restoration from an essential to a critical need due to safety concerns, and keeping it as a two-year phased project.

The Committee discussed the need to align removal of the Stokes Road bridge with the NHDOT's reconfiguration of the Route 28/Route 128 intersection, and agreed it could be moved to 2028. This will be marked for further discussion by the Planning Board.
The Committee agreed to combine all security access control systems into 2028, as they are an immediate need.
The Committee agreed on the following: ERP and HRIS finance system should stay in 2028.
The Committee agreed on the following: Fire apparatus needs to be ordered in 2027; it will be paid for at a future date.

The Committee agreed on the following: Leach Library: Children's Room renovation will be completed over several years; a bond warrant article will be presented for the Library renovation project in 2028.
The Committee agreed on the following: The DPW facility will stay in 2029, which will most likely be a bond and possibly spread across multiple years.
The Committee agreed to the purchase of a skid steer and mini-excavator in 2028, due to it being an essential need.
The Committee agreed having the water project on the CIP shows a need, which will help obtain grants. They agreed on the proposed schedule as presented.
Pillsbury Cemetery expansion should be moved to 2030, to wait for a plan and concrete numbers.
The School turf field and turf project will be moved to 2028.

ERP and HRIS finance system in 2028
